Episode 213: Rift, A Precursor to a Great Change (1)
November 20, 1803.
Ameris had come to terms with the fact that the Demon-Sealing Wall was falling apart.

"Yes… The entrance to the underworld is only guarded by my main body in the old Oterium, but it doesn't really matter if it's an entrance or not. While that entrance can be opened and closed at my will, it can be breached anywhere if struck."
After Jin and Murakan met Kinzelo, Ameris often complained of headaches, retracing her lost memories.
-The Demon-Sealing Wall is already partially destroyed, Jin. Ameris probably doesn't remember this fact. That's why she asked you to find out how we are controlling the demons.
-It's already partially destroyed?

-The ancient royal tribes, the Blue Tribe and the Red Tribe, destroyed it. At that time, Ameris quickly repaired the Demon-Sealing Wall… but some of the demons living underground had already escaped to the middle world. The middle ground between the surface and the underground.
Just like the conversation with Jephrine at the Kinzelo headquarters, Ameris had completely forgotten that the Demon-Sealing Wall had been destroyed.

"So the ancient royal tribes destroyed part of the Demon-Sealing Wall… and now Zito is regaining strength, accelerating the collapse. Plus, I just now remember Paelito, that demon. The Sword Demon, the Supreme Sword of the Demon World."
According to Ameris, not only Paelito, but many demons with transcendent powers existed in the Demon World. Among them, Zito was a threat of a different dimension.
Ameris felt guilt. She failed to fulfill her sole destiny given after the death of the Sun God.

"Even now, it's dangerous for me to try to fix the seal. Just like Orgal said, trying to recover the seal with my power might actually lead to more collapse. It's sad to lose the power of the golden age."
"I know that feeling well. Don't be too depressed, Mister Ameris. Who knows, you might recover and become stronger like me?"
"Most of the entities that were in my head have already vanished, I can't find them even if I want to, Murakan."
"Then you have to train to get stronger. If you need help, just tell me, I'll help you."
"Training is okay, but for some reason, I just feel like beating you senselessly."

"The other day, there was also a message from the Holy Kingdom. Ayura sent a revelation to the Holy King. He said there will be a great change in the world soon and to keep the Advent Festival going."
The Advent Festival is a celebration commemorating Ayura's first advent in the Holy Kingdom Vankela, with the 'King's Ascension Ceremony' being the biggest event.
However, the Advent Festival that Ayura asked Rani for this time was different. He wanted all the believers of the Holy Kingdom to pray so that he could actually manifest.
"Transition. Was that the revelation the Holy King heard?"
"Yes, it was about the impending transition of the Demon Realm to the surface."
That was why Ayulra was desperately trying to descend to the Holy Kingdom, even if only for a moment.
"From what I heard from Murakan, that immortal named Ayulra is known for purging other immortals who interfere excessively with the surface world. Is he planning to join in exterminating Zito?"

"That would be difficult, it's more for the sake of protecting the Holy Kingdom. He said he would take measures to prevent the Demon Realm from transitioning to the Holy Kingdom and go further to cast a barrier that will protect the entire Holy Kingdom from moderate demons."

"It's a bit disappointing, but that alone will be of great help. After the great upheaval begins, as Ayulra said, we will no longer need to constantly have our main forces on standby in the Holy Kingdom."
"Ayulra, if that old man is moving this quickly, it's practically confirmed that the demons are coming up soon. Orgal also said that it wouldn't be strange if the demons came up in a few days."

"The Red Bright Tribe will also be retrieving their old powers, Jin. The fact that the Red Devil War did not lean towards the Zephyr side immediately despite the appearance of Elona Zephyr is proof of that."
For instance, the current situation was no different from a gunpowder depot in front of a field of oil that could explode at any moment.

It would be a problem if the Red Bright Tribe restored their main forces including the incarnated god, it would be fatal if Zephyr completed the Magic Stone and put forth Elona, and Zito and the demons of the Demon Realm are preparing to transition in order to turn the world into hell.

In addition to the palace, whose whereabouts and exact forces were hard to determine, the existence of the Sun God Religion and Sanah, and Lokiarnest, who is suspected to be the biggest villain in all this.
'Even though I've become so powerful and the Barmel Alliance has grown so big... there are still so many overwhelming tasks.'
In the absence of Shiron now, Jin is the person closest to the First Blade of the Human World.
Yet, there wasn't much that Jin could solve on his own. This wasn't a selfish fight for survival. Such a fight did not match Jin's purpose or will.
What they could hope for at present was for the scattered bombs to explode later rather than sooner, and for the geniuses led by Dr. Quall to achieve the Alliance's secret weapon as soon as possible.

'The mass production of Eello and the completion of the Golden Fleet, the liberation of Laprarosa. The mass production of Eello is a matter of time. However, I may have no choice but to rely on the variable of Phaetel for the completion of the Golden Fleet and the liberation of Laprarosa.'

-Yes, Thunder Dragon Kaltor. I plan to attempt communication with Phaetel when he awakens. The power of Phaetel is thunder, and fundamentally, it has as much authority as a god. I think it might be the answer.
-I'm not sure if that scared and frivolous god will help... I don't even know if he will provide help.

-I've heard stories about Phaetel begging for his life from Lord Murakan during your squire days. You must have some residual negative feelings. So, if he refuses to cooperate, then Lord Murakan will have to lose again. What would happen then?

Jin gave a bitter smile, recalling the conversation he had with Valeria not long ago. Even the calm and rational Valeria had no choice but to say that the Golden Fleet and the Laprarosa liberation project were in a deadlocked state.
“Jet.”
"Yes, my lord!"
"Do you have any word from Yulian or the dedicated healers about when the Thunder Dragon Kaltor will wake up?"

"Yes, my lord. The situation with the dragon named Kaltor is very good these days. They said he could regain full consciousness within a week at the earliest and within a month at the latest. Please wait a bit more."
"Hmm... I see."
A week, a month didn't seem long, yet it felt far away. The state of the world was putting that much pressure on Jin.

'Is it a relief that Orgal promised to give infinite support without compensation regarding the matter of the Demon Realm this time?... But that promise can be broken at any time if Kinzelo's situation turns favourable for some reason.'
Jin sighed and said,
"Oh, it would be nice if powerful reinforcements appeared out of nowhere like magic."
Of course, Jin was completely unaware of the fact that Luna and Zed, along with the former Black Knights, were now returning from the Black Sea.
"Huh, kid. How long has it been since I returned, and you're saying that? It's disappointing. Am I not enough for you?"
"Yeah, strangely, it does feel a bit lacking."
"You rascal."
"We're the only ones among the large forces that care so much about the peace between ordinary mortals and humans and fight like this, so it can't be helped."
In the midst of these various concerns, a resonating sound came from the communication device on the table. It was a transmission from the empire.
{Jin.}
Jin immediately noticed the urgency in his friend's voice.
"Dante, what's going on?"
{Can you come here now? We've received a report of a strange phenomenon in the Meltdor Empire.}
"A strange phenomenon?"
{Do you remember the city of Rompra in Meltdor?}
"I remember. It's where I met Kidad Hull."

{A strange rift, presumably a dimensional gate, has appeared there... I was going to contact you after confirming first, but I was concerned about the 'transition' you mentioned a while ago. I think it's probably related.}
"Huh, has it already started? You did well to contact me, Dante. I will go to Hyran 2 immediately, so please wait a bit."
{Thank you, I understand.}
After ending the communication, Jin sighed again without realizing it.

"No time for frustration. Right, long-range communication device. Thanks to getting this technology in advance, we can respond immediately like now when problems arise. Let's go, Murakan. I think it would be good to take Lord Ameris with us this time."
"That's the way to go. Although I have lost my memory, there should be no one who knows better about the energy of the Demon Realm than me."
"My lord, what should we do about Kinzelo? Should we ask Siris to inform them about the fact that a rift has occurred?"
"No, we don't need to share all information with Orgal. We'll check it out first, and if we need more information, we'll meet Orgal."
"Understood!"
As soon as Jin arrived at Rompra on the Red Owl, he narrowed his forehead, recalling his past encounters with Kidad Hull.
'If there is a place commonly referred to as hell in the Demon Realm, is that guy suffering there now?'

Rompra was the same as when Jin was a reserve rider. Despite the presence of the Sword Emperor's Palace and the Shrine of Evil, which had turned the whole world into chaos, this small harbor city in the frontier had an unchanged and quiet scenery.

However, hidden within that tranquil scenery was the fear of ordinary people. There was not a single fishing boat that had started fishing in the harbor, and it was hard to find people on the streets.
This was due to a rift that had formed out of nowhere in the middle of the city.
"So, that's the rift..."
"It's clear that it's continuing to grow little by little, as described in the report, Jin."
Ameris said this, shaking her head as soon as she saw the rift.

"I'm sure. That's the energy of the Demon Realm. It seems to be a form of summoning magic... Are they trying to transfer cities in the Demon Realm like this? This land will soon be eroded by the demons underground."
While the group was confirming the rift, similar reports were being written in various places including the Empire, the Bamul Union, and the Lutero Federation.
Rifts, similar to the one that appeared in Rompra, were cropping up all over the surface like tumors.
